title: As a Commercial Customer Operations Lead, I want to view daily consumption for an authorized site and date range so that I can understand day-to-day usage.
description: This FR-2 story presents one daily consumption value per calendar day from accepted readings and an explicit no-data state when the selected site and range have no accepted data.
goal: view daily consumption for an authorized site and date range
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected site has accepted meter readings for a selected date range, when a user selects the daily view, then the dashboard displays one consumption value per calendar day derived from readings in that range.

Given no accepted consumption data exists for a selected site and date range, when a user opens or changes the dashboard view, then the dashboard displays an explicit no-data state and does not represent the absence of data as zero consumption.
dependencies: Accepted site-associated meter-reading dataset from FR-1.
Approved customer organization and site authorization source.
